name: Smarter and Harder (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Opportunities Aplenty class feature

Benefit(s): When wielding only one weapon which is a light or one-handed weapon, and your other hand is empty, you may add your Intelligence modifier to all attack rolls that would normally add opportunities aplenty damage on a successful hit.
